description: SQL Injection is a web security vulnerability that allows an attacker to interfere with the queries that an application makes to its database.
misconfigurations: Using string concatenation for SQL queries instead of prepared statements
real_world_incidents: TalkTalk data breach, numerous high-profile compromises of user databases.
recommended_actions: Enforce least privilege on the DB user.

audience_guidance.student: SQL injection happens when an app mistakes user input for a database command, letting hackers steal data.
audience_guidance.developer: Never concatenate strings to build SQL. Always use ORMs or parameterized queries provided by your framework.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Test all inputs (GET, POST, Headers) with single quotes, sleep() payloads, and logic operators.
audience_guidance.pentester: Use sqlmap to automate extraction once confirmed, attempt to read local files or gain shell via xp_cmdshell/UDF.
audience_guidance.security_team: Deploy WAFs with strict SQLi rules and mandate SAST/DAST scanning in the SDLC.
